_comment: bootstrap config. Copy to bootstrap.config.json and fill in. All addresses are base58 pubkeys. Amounts/prices are integers in base units. See solana/README.md 'Deployment process'.
quoteMint: REQUIRED: base58 pubkey of the already-deployed quote mint (e.g. USDC)
_profileDigest_comment: Compute BEFORE bootstrapping, from the Asset Profile JSON you author offline: `cd server && go run ./cmd/canonicalize <profile.json>`. Permanent at initialize. The same document is later POSTed to /api/v1/profile, and the server refuses it unless it hashes to this. See solana/README.md 'Deployment process' step 5.
auditorEth: REQUIRED: 0x-prefixed 20-byte auditor eth address (the offline signer holds the key)

roles.admin: REQUIRED: registry/config admin + deployer (must equal the programs' upgrade authority at finalize)
